vibe: Premium, minimalist, high-end sports prediction with dramatic dark mode and purple accents

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8 for cards.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room layout for dashboard/ranking, Tetris Grid for match cards if needed. Default to grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 for match lists.

components.surface_strategy: Glassmorphism (Crystal Glass) for sticky headers and modals (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#030008]/70 border-b border-white/10). Solid slightly elevated dark backgrounds for Match Cards with 1px border.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI Form & Input. bg-white/5 border border-white/10 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 rounded-lg text-center font-bold text-xl.
components.buttons: Shadcn UI Button. primary uses bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white rounded-lg shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(139,92,246,0.3)] transition-all. secondary uses bg-white/5 border border-white/10.
components.toast: Use Sonner for 'Guardado con éxito'. Dark mode styling with emerald green check icon and text.
components.avatar: Purple background (bg-purple-600) with white text initials, rounded-full.
components.tables: Shadcn UI Table. border-collapse, subtle border-b border-white/10. Active user row highlighted with bg-purple-900/20.

hero_login_background.description: Dark black sand with a soccer ball. Use with bg-black/60 overlay for login page background.

dashboard_header_bg.description: Abstract soccer stadium night light. Use at very low opacity (10%) as a page background texture.

icons.usage: Use duotone or bold weights for strong sporting presence.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI entirely with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
Use standard HTML inputs customized via Tailwind for the exact score prediction logic, ensuring focus states have high contrast.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='save-prediction-button', data-testid='login-submit-button').
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for main structural layouts to allow high customization, rather than restrictive layout components.
Apply backdrop-blur to sticky headers and navs, maintaining at least 1px border-white/10 for definition.
Do not use generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Integrate 'Outfit' for headers and 'Manrope' for body from Google Fonts.
Ensure that 'Guardado con éxito' uses Sonner toast with a success state.
For the ranking, implement the point calculation logic efficiently and highlight the current logged-in user in the table.
DO NOT use placeholder images. Use the team logos provided in media_urls.
